weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入獅子座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往獅子座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，今天的天體排列鼓勵你退後一步，反思自己的生活以及周圍人的生活。是時候認識到你最近可能有點以自我為中心了。請記住，您並不是宇宙的唯一焦點，因此請考慮為什麼您可能會表現得好像您是宇宙的唯一焦點。利用這一天與朋友和家人伸出援手，彌合任何裂痕；他們會非常高興再次擁抱你。
aries.horoscope_en: The celestial alignments today encourage you, Aries, to take a step back and reflect on your own life as well as the lives of those around you. It's time to recognize that you may have been a bit self-centered recently. Remember, you’re not the sole focus of the universe, so consider why you might have been acting as if you were. Use this day to reach out and mend any rifts with friends and family; they will be more than happy to embrace you once again.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 今天是你與你的伴侶金牛座開誠佈公的絕佳機會。看來你們的關係可能​​陷入了停滯。您有責任重新點燃激情和興奮。你怎麼能這樣做呢？你已經知道答案了——為你們兩個人騰出一些美好時光。穿上特別的衣服，在頂級餐廳訂一張桌子，然後看著您和您所愛的人重新建立聯繫並茁壯成長。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today is the perfect opportunity for you to be open and honest with your partner, Taurus. It seems your relationship may have hit a bit of a standstill. It's your responsibility to reignite that passion and excitement. How can you do this? You already know the answer – carve out some quality time just for the two of you. Put on something special, book a table at that top-notch restaurant, and watch as you and your loved one reconnect and thrive.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 今天充滿潛力，雙子座！如果您覺得自己還沒有充分發揮自己的創造力，那麼今天就是擺脫這種擔憂的日子。你的想像力是無限的，你會清楚地看到這一點。對可能出現的意外情況保持警惕；你遇到的一個人或一個情況可能會為你的生活帶來重大改變。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today is brimming with potential, Gemini! If you've felt like you haven't tapped into your creative abilities fully, today is the day to let go of that worry. Your imagination knows no limits, and you'll come to see that clearly. Stay alert for unexpected chances that may arise; a person or situation you come across could lead to significant changes in your life.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，你可能會感覺到周圍有一些潛在的緊張氣氛。雖然這不是你的錯，但保持低調可能是明智之舉，尤其是當你有任務要完成時。避免任何爭論；僅僅因為有人想要打架並不意味著你需要參與。保持距離最符合你的利益，在你意識到之前，這一切都會在明天過去，成為再次社交的更好時機。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you might sense some underlying tension around you. While it's not your fault, it could be wise to stay under the radar, particularly if you have tasks to complete. Steer clear of any debates; just because someone is looking for a fight doesn't mean you need to engage. It's in your best interest to maintain your distance, and before you know it, this will all pass by tomorrow, making it a better time to socialize again.

leo.horoscope: 身為獅子座，你的精神自然傾向於夢想，而不是沉迷於生活的實際情況。這種傾向常常導致忘記日常任務，例如去雜貨店購物或取乾洗衣服。當其他人為你處理這些細節時，你就會蓬勃發展。然而，今天的活動將要求您自己承擔一些日常職責。當這一天結束時，你會因為自己能夠自力更生而感到滿足，即使這不是你最喜歡的消磨時間的方式。
leo.horoscope_en: As a Leo, your spirit is naturally inclined towards dreaming rather than dwelling on the practicalities of life. This tendency often leads to forgetting everyday tasks like grocery shopping or picking up dry cleaning. You thrive when others take care of these details for you. However, today’s events will require you to tackle some of these routine responsibilities yourself. By the time the day wraps up, you'll find a sense of satisfaction in your ability to be self-reliant, even if it’s not your preferred way to spend your time.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天相信你的直覺並接受一點冒險，你將獲得豐厚的回報。您擁有將紮實的專案提升為非凡專案的才能。盡量避免分心，將注意力集中在整體目標上，而不是迷失在細節中。你會發現，透過解決主要問題，較小的問題自然會迎刃而解。
virgo.horoscope_en: Trust your gut and embrace a little risk-taking today, Virgo, and you'll reap significant rewards. You possess the talent to elevate a solid project into something exceptional. Try to avoid distractions and maintain your focus on the overarching goals instead of getting lost in the minutiae. You'll discover that by addressing the major concerns, the smaller ones will naturally fall into place.
virgo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你終於可以帶著期待已久的輕鬆感呼氣了。如果財務問題一直困擾著你，那麼今天帶來了一個可喜的改變。您可能會發現您的情況顯著改善，或出現了一個明確的策略來幫助您恢復穩定。您為解決這些財務問題所做的辛勤努力正在得到回報，使您能夠將注意力轉移到更有效率的工作上。
libra.horoscope_en: At last, Libra, you can exhale with a sense of relief that has been long awaited. If financial concerns have been weighing on your mind, today brings a welcome change. You may find that your situation improves significantly or that a clear strategy emerges to help you regain stability. Your diligent efforts to tackle these financial issues are paying off, allowing you to shift your focus towards working more efficiently.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天是區分那些真正重要的人和那些不重要的人的絕佳機會。反思你的人際關係並找出你真正的朋友。你的忠誠值得讚揚，但請考慮是否值得向那些沒有回報的人表達你的忠誠。您已經為這些所謂的朋友提供了無數的機會來表達他們的關心。現在是時候把他們從你的生活中釋放出來，為那些真正珍惜你們友誼的人騰出空間了。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today is the perfect opportunity to distinguish between those who truly matter and those who don't. Reflect on your relationships and identify your genuine friends. Your loyalty is commendable, but consider whether it’s worth extending to those who don’t reciprocate. You've already offered these so-called friends numerous opportunities to show their care. Now is the moment to release them from your life and make room for the people who truly value your friendship.
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，無論你是否意識到，創造力是你存在的核心。即使您不認為自己是藝術家或作家，您也應該接受這個角色。你的腦海中充滿了渴望被付諸實踐的富有想像力的概念。為什麼不冒險一試呢？你將獲得一切，並且你可能會對你能創造的奇蹟感到驚訝。請記住，您的大腦有兩個半球 - 是時候同時利用兩個半球了！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, whether you realize it or not, creativity is at the heart of your existence. Even if you don't consider yourself an artist or a writer, you should embrace that role. Your mind is brimming with imaginative concepts eager to be brought to life. Why not take the plunge? You have everything to gain, and you might be surprised by the wonders you can create. Remember, your brain has two hemispheres—it's time to tap into both!
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天你的腦子裡充滿了疑問──有些是沉重的，有些是輕鬆的。很明顯，這些問題佔據了你的思考空間，而解決方案讓人感覺難以捉摸。但別擔心；當這一天結束時，一切都會變得清晰起來。當前的行星排列將照亮你最近面臨的令人困惑的情況，讓你的生活恢復平靜和秩序。擁抱這種新發現的寧靜。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, your mind is buzzing with inquiries today—some weighty, others more lighthearted. It’s clear that these questions are taking up your mental space, and the solutions feel elusive. But don’t worry; by the time the day wraps up, clarity will emerge. The current planetary alignments are set to illuminate the puzzling situations you've faced lately, restoring a sense of peace and order to your life. Embrace this newfound tranquility.

aquarius.horoscope: 作為水瓶座，你的個性閃閃發光，但你可能會發現為了滿足工作需求而降低它的挑戰性。問題可能不在於你，而在於你目前的工作。如果你感到缺乏快樂或覺得你的創造力沒有充分利用，現在可能是考慮重大轉變的最佳時機。把握機遇，迎接新挑戰！
aquarius.horoscope_en: As an Aquarius, your individuality shines brightly, but you might find it challenging to tone it down to meet work demands. It’s possible that the issue lies not with you, but with your current job. If you sense a lack of joy or feel that your creative talents are underutilized, now could be the perfect moment to consider a significant shift. Embrace the opportunity to tackle new challenges!

pisces.horoscope: 最近發生的事件可能會讓你感到有點受傷。你是否認為你掌握著治癒所受傷害的鑰匙？這不是對抗，而是對抗。這是關於開啟對話。所涉及的個人甚至可能沒有意識到他們的言語或行為的影響。分享你的感受可能會導致真誠的道歉，而解決問題所帶來的清晰性也會使你們雙方受益。
pisces.horoscope_en: Recent events may have left you feeling a bit wounded. Have you considered that you hold the key to mending the hurt you experienced? This isn't about confrontation; it's about opening a dialogue. The individual involved may not even realize the impact of their words or actions. Sharing your feelings could lead to a heartfelt apology, and both of you will benefit from the clarity that comes from addressing the issue.
